extension.summary: Install and update IntroSkip for Kodi 22
extension.description: Unofficial repository containing IntroSkip: TV recap, intro, outro and movie credit skip prompts using Cinemeta, IntroDB and Kodi 22 chapters.

extension.summary: Skip intros, recaps and credits with IntroDB and Kodi 22 chapters.
extension.description: IntroSkip finds opening sequences, recaps and credits in TV episodes and movies. It uses community timestamps from IntroDB and named Kodi 22 chapters to show customizable skip buttons. Cinemeta identifies titles without API keys. Choose Ask or Auto for each type of segment; automatic skipping only uses qualifying timestamp evidence.
extension.news: 0.0.24 corrects the Kodi 22 Python dependency minimum to 3.1.0, declares a requests minimum, and improves add-on metadata. Detection and button behavior are unchanged from 0.0.23.
